Original Decipher card face for [[Thrown Back|Thrown Back]], as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/images/thrownback.jpg thrownback.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Edits: cropped to the black card border, and the corner pads outside the border set to white. The card face itself is unchanged.

The Holotable face used on the card page is [[:File:Cor-L-thrownback.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
